metric_model: CHAOSS AI Alignment - Community Governed Use

scope.note: Scoring confined to the files named on the command line; 'no' means not addressed in those files.

domains.suggested_improvement: no AI supervision level, scope limit, or accountability holder stated
domains.reasoning: CONTRIBUTING.md never mentions AI at all. It states the project does not accept outside PRs, but says nothing about AI-assisted contributions.

domains.suggested_improvement: no mention of meeting/notetaker bots or recording policy
domains.reasoning: No reference to meetings, recording, or notetaker bots exists in the document.

domains.suggested_improvement: no AI rule for documentation or content contributions
domains.reasoning: The document discusses issue reporting and a 'human language policy' for text but does not mention AI-generated content, documentation, or design assets.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on AI use in moderation actions
domains.reasoning: The document describes human-enforced bad-faith/brigading bans but does not mention AI being used for moderation, nor restrict/permit it.
No mention of who or what may review contributions using AI; reviews are implied to be by maintainers only, but AI is never referenced.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on autonomous/agentic AI use
domains.reasoning: No mention of agentic or autonomous AI systems operating on the project.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on environmental impact of AI use
domains.reasoning: The document contains no discussion of energy, water, or hardware/carbon footprint concerns tied to AI.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on infrastructure strain from AI tooling
domains.reasoning: No mention of server load, CI cost, or hardware financing concerns related to AI.

domains.suggested_improvement: no statement on use of project/user data for AI training
domains.reasoning: No mention of training data usage, user data, or model training practices.

consent_policy_specificity.overall_posture: CONTRIBUTING.md contains no AI-specific policy language whatsoever; it addresses contributor conduct, issue reporting, language style, and neutrality, but never mentions AI, so all nine domains are unaddressed within this document.

awaiting_implementation.specific_tools_in_use: Awaiting implementation: named-product detection beyond known file signatures
awaiting_implementation.ai_tool_owner: Awaiting implementation: ownership and data control
awaiting_implementation.environmental_footprint: Awaiting implementation: model/system card and ESG disclosure
awaiting_implementation.proportionality: Awaiting implementation: resource use relative to contributor count (needs platform usage data)

use_composition_partial.note: Detection only. Absence of signal is not absence of use.

policy_change.blocker: Draft classifier not wired in or validated against hand-graded history. Repo.history() and Repo.commit_patch() supply the diffs.

use_compliance.blocker: Derived metric. Requires disclosed-use data (Use Composition) checked against the specificity grid. Composition is only partially detectable, so the comparison is not yet sound.

misuse.blocker: Not automatable. CHAOSS marks the core signals unknown: text-based AI detectors are unreliable, and license-laundering and wrongful-accusation incidents need maintainer self-report.
